subject: Outstanding items for Meridian Fabrication
body:
Hi David,

I'm following up on the items below. We have not yet received them:

- Signed management representation letter for the Q4 2024 package (first requested January 21, 2025)
- Updated accounts receivable aging report (first requested January 21, 2025)
- Updated financial projections, specifically updated 12-month cash flow projections with assumptions stated (first requested April 10, 2024)
- Aerospace contract purchase order documentation (first requested January 23, 2025)
- Customer names on the 60-90 day accounts receivable items (first requested January 31, 2025)
- Q1 2025 covenant compliance package (first requested March 14, 2025)

Please reply by the end of this week with the date you will send these. If something is holding up any of them, let's set up a short call this week to work through it.

Thanks,
Sarah
